# Firecrawl — Style Reference

> Graph paper on a drafting table, one ember lit. Suisse at weight 500 over a #f9f9f9 canvas, hairline grid rules with crosshair corners, bracketed Geist Mono annotations, and a single ember orange reserved for whatever runs.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Firecrawl speaks a schematic-blueprint product language: the page is drawn like an engineering sheet, with square hairline cells, crosshair corner ticks and bracketed mono annotations such as "[ 01 / 07 ]". The canvas is Paper Canvas #f9f9f9. Linen Surface #ffffff lifts panels, Dove Fill #efefef backs quiet controls and Graphite Ink #262626 carries the text. The chromatic budget is exactly one hue. Ember Signal #ff4d00 fills the primary action, colors the second line of every headline, the JSON string values and the section index numbers, and its pale cousin Sand Tint #f9c2ab appears only on tiny tags. Typography is Suisse at 400, 450 and 500 with tracking near -0.01em at display sizes. The scale jumps from 24px straight to 40px, so hierarchy comes from that gap and from ember color rather than from bold weights. Square frames hold softened controls at 8 to 20px radius, and elevation comes from pale rings and near-invisible stacked shadows. The page reads as a lab instrument rather than a marketing brochure.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paper Canvas | `#f9f9f9` | `--color-paper-canvas` | Page background, grid cell fill, and the 6px moat ring around panels (16 ring uses) — the off-white lets pure white panels lift without any drop shadow. |
| Linen Surface | `#ffffff` | `--color-linen-surface` | Search composer, code windows, active mode tabs and the "2 Months Free" pill — the elevated plane, distinguished from the canvas by a 6-point lightness step. |
| Dove Fill | `#efefef` | `--color-dove-fill` | Sign-up button, inactive segmented chips and code-tab backgrounds — a tonal control fill that signals "clickable" without spending any chroma. |
| Graphite Ink | `#262626` | `--color-graphite-ink` | Headlines, nav links, body copy and the wordmark fill — a softened black that keeps 60px type from punching harder than the ember accent. |
| Pewter Caption | `#999999` | `--color-pewter-caption` | Subheadings beside bold lead-ins, input placeholders and secondary descriptions — the second voice that recedes one full step behind Graphite Ink. |
| Ash Gutter | `#c2c2c2` | `--color-ash-gutter` | Code line numbers, bracketed mono labels, traffic-light dots and inactive index digits (92 uses) — the annotation gray of the blueprint. Do not use it for readable body copy. |
| Fog Hairline | `#ededed` | `--color-fog-hairline` | Estimated from screenshots: 1px grid rules, cell dividers and panel strokes (40 bordered elements) — the line work that turns the page into graph paper. |
| Onyx Dot | `#000000` | `--color-onyx-dot` | The arrow disc inside the promo pill and the GitHub mark — a pure-black pinpoint reserved for icon-scale use only. Do not use it for text or large fills. |
| Ember Signal | `#ff4d00` | `--color-ember-signal` | Primary CTA fill, announcement banner, headline second lines, JSON strings and section index numbers — the only saturated hue, and it always means live or actionable. |
| Sand Tint | `#f9c2ab` | `--color-sand-tint` | "NEW" tag fill and highlighted token chips inside mockups — Ember diluted for small labels. Do not promote it to a button or a section background. |
| Frosted Glyph | `#ffffffdb` | `--color-frosted-glyph` | Ink for the Roboto Mono ASCII dust fields behind the hero and section heads (127 uses) — decorative-only texture whose intensity is set by the parent layer. |
| Smoke Veil | `#0000001a` | `--color-smoke-veil` | Hover wash on pills and chips — a 10% black overlay that darkens any surface by one step without introducing a new gray. |

## Tokens — Typography

### Suisse — the display and UI voice, measured and quiet at every size · `--font-suisse`

- **Substitute:** Inter at 450 for UI and 500 for headings (Inter draws a hair wider and heavier than Suisse, so use 400 for 16px body), Geist at 450 and 500, Hanken Grotesk at 450 and 500. Suisse renders close to its nominal weight, so match the numbers rather than stepping up.
- **Weights:** 400, 450, 500
- **Sizes:** 10px, 12px, 13px, 14px, 15px, 16px, 20px, 24px, 40px, 52px, 60px
- **Line height:** 1.0 (10px badges) to 1.5 (16px body). Display sizes use 1.067 to 1.1.
- **Letter spacing:** 0.26px at 13px, 0.24px at 12px uppercase, 0.14px at 14px, -0.1px at 20px, -0.24px at 24px, -0.4px at 40px, -0.52px at 52px, -0.3px at 60px
- **Role:** The ceiling weight is 500, applied to 40 to 60px headlines, where most SaaS sites jump to 700. This is deliberate. The headline has authority through size and ember color, not stroke mass. Weight 450 (a Book cut) is the workhorse for buttons and UI labels and gives controls 50 units more presence than paragraph text. The scale is anti-convention: 16→20→24 behaves like a Major Third (1.25), then leaps 1.67× to 40px and compresses to 1.15× between 52px and 60px. Hierarchy lives in that gap, not in a smooth ladder.

### Geist Mono — the annotation and code voice of the schematic · `--font-geist-mono`

- **Substitute:** Geist Mono at 400 (free, identical), JetBrains Mono at 400 (draws slightly heavier, keep it at 400), IBM Plex Mono at 400.
- **Weights:** 400, 500
- **Sizes:** 12px, 13px, 14px
- **Line height:** 1.333 (12px), 1.538 (13px), 1.571 (14px code)
- **Letter spacing:** normal at all sizes, uppercase at 12px for labels
- **Role:** Mono carries 223 elements, more than half the count of the main face. It is a co-equal second voice, not the token code font most product sites treat it as. It sets every code window at 14/22, and in uppercase 12px with square brackets it writes the blueprint's margin notes ("[ .JSON ]", "[ 200 OK ]", "MAIN FEATURES"). Pairing a Swiss grotesk with a geometric mono makes the page read as an engineering document rather than an advertisement.

### Roboto Mono — the micro-texture of ASCII dust fields · `--font-roboto-mono`

- **Substitute:** Roboto Mono at 400 (free, identical), Fira Mono at 400.
- **Weights:** 400
- **Sizes:** 8.274px
- **Line height:** 1.115
- **Letter spacing:** normal at 8.274px
- **Role:** Used 127 times at a deliberately non-integer 8.274px, this face is texture, not text. It renders the scattered ASCII glyph clouds behind the hero and section heads, and its odd size comes from fitting a character grid to a fixed width. Never treat it as a readable size. It is a halftone screen built from characters.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | Geist Mono | 400 | 12px | 1.333 | 0px | `--text-small` |
| caption | Suisse | 400 | 13px | 1.538 | 0px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | Suisse | 400 | 14px | 1.429 | 0.14px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | Suisse | 400 | 16px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | Suisse | 400 | 20px | 1.4 | -0.1px | `--text-body-lg` |
| subheading | Suisse | 500 | 24px | 1.333 | -0.24px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading | Suisse | 500 | 40px | 1.1 | -0.4px | `--text-heading` |
| heading-lg | Suisse | 500 | 52px | 1.077 | -0.52px | `--text-heading-lg` |
| display | Suisse | 500 | 60px | 1.067 | -0.3px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every headline at Suisse weight 500 with tracking near -0.01em (-0.52px at 52px) — size and color carry the hierarchy, so the weight stays measured.
- Render the second line or key word of each headline in Ember Signal #ff4d00 — the two-tone headline is the signature and repeats on every section head.
- Build sections inside a 1112px frame of 1px Fog Hairline #ededed cells with crosshair ticks at intersections — the graph-paper grid is the composition, not a background ornament.
- Annotate with Geist Mono 12px uppercase in Ash Gutter #c2c2c2 inside square brackets — the mono margin notes make the page read as a specification.
- Lift panels with a 6px Paper Canvas #f9f9f9 ring plus shadows at 3% black or less — elevation is felt as a moat, not seen as a cast shadow.
- Keep controls at 8 to 10px radius and cards at 16 to 20px, and use 999px only for chips and tabs — frames stay square at 0px so softened objects read as handheld tools on a drafted sheet.
- Show code and JSON as the hero illustration in Geist Mono 14px/22px with Ember string values — the product's output is the most persuasive image available.

### Don't

- Don't add a second saturated hue for "success" or "info" states — the chromatic budget is one ember, and a green or blue status color dilutes the meaning of #ff4d00 as live.
- Don't push headlines to weight 700 because 60px "needs punch" — Suisse at 500 with -0.3px tracking is the deliberate restraint, and bold weight would make Graphite Ink #262626 compete with the ember line.
- Don't set the sign-up or selector button in Ember — only one 10px-radius ember fill per view is non-negotiable, and secondary actions stay Dove Fill #efefef.
- Don't replace the ring-and-moat elevation with a conventional 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.15) drop shadow — a visible cast shadow breaks the flat-sheet illusion that 3% layers preserve.
- Don't round the grid frames or section containers — the 0px frame radius is what makes the 20px cards read as objects placed on a drawing.
- Don't use the 8.274px Roboto Mono ASCII texture for readable copy or let it exceed the Frosted Glyph #ffffffdb intensity — it is a halftone screen, and readable glyphs would turn texture into noise.
- Never use Ash Gutter #c2c2c2 for paragraph text, and never drop body copy below 13px — #c2c2c2 on #f9f9f9 is annotation contrast, not reading contrast.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #f9f9f9 (Paper Canvas)
- elevated surface: #ffffff (Linen Surface)
- primary text: #262626 (Graphite Ink)
- secondary text: #999999 (Pewter Caption)
- annotations and line numbers: #c2c2c2 (Ash Gutter)
- hairline: #ededed (Fog Hairline)
- primary action: #ff4d00 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts and bars stay neutral in Graphite Ink #262626 and Ash Gutter #c2c2c2 on Fog Hairline gridlines, with Ember Signal #ff4d00 as a solid fill on the single highlighted series or value only, so the accent marks the answer rather than decorating every bar.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: background #ff4d00, text #ffffff, no border, border-radius 10px, padding 8px, height 36px, font Suisse (fallback Inter) 14px weight 450, line-height 20px, letter-spacing 0px. Apply box-shadow `inset 0px -6px 12px 0px color(display-p3 0.9804 0.1127 0.098 / 0.2), 0px 2px 4px 0px color(display-p3 0.9804 0.3647 0.098 / 0.12), 0px 1px 1px 0px color(display-p3 0.9804 0.3647 0.098 / 0.12), 0px 0.5px 0.5px 0px color(display-p3 0.9804 0.3647 0.098 / 0.16), 0px 0.25px 0.25px 0px color(display-p3 0.9804 0.3647 0.098 / 0.2)`. Label it "Start for free". Place a secondary button beside it with background #ffffff, text #262626, radius 10px, height 40px and box-shadow `0px 0px 0px 2px rgb(249, 249, 249)`, separated by a 12px gap.

2. Build a hero section on background #f9f9f9 inside a 1112px max-width frame. Draw a background grid of 1px #ededed lines in square cells, with small #ff4d00 four-point sparkles at two intersections. Center a pill (background #ffffff, radius 999px, padding 4px 4px 4px 8px, Suisse 12px weight 450, text #262626) ending in a 16px #000000 circle with a white arrow. Below it, 24px down, place an h1 in Suisse 60px weight 500, line-height 64px, letter-spacing -0.3px: line one in #262626, line two in #ff4d00. Add a 16px subline in #262626 at 1.5 line-height, max-width 520px, then the button pair 24px below.

3. Build a feature card grid: three columns of 347×212px cards on a 1px #ededed ruled grid, each with background #ffffff, border-radius 20px, padding 32px 0, no shadow, and content centered. Each card holds a 24px pixel-dot icon drawn in #ff4d00 and #c2c2c2 squares, a 16px gap, a title in Suisse 16px weight 450 #262626, and a description in Suisse 16px weight 400 #999999. On one card, add a "NEW" tag after the title: background #f9c2ab, text #ff4d00, Suisse 10px weight 500, radius 4px, padding 2px 4px.

4. Build a code window: background #ffffff, radius 16px 16px 0px 0px, box-shadow `0px 0px 0px 6px rgb(249, 249, 249)`, header height 28px with three 8px circle outlines in #c2c2c2 and a "[ .JSON ]" label in Geist Mono 12px uppercase #c2c2c2 at the right, 12px padding. Body in Geist Mono 14px weight 400, line-height 22px, padding 16px 20px: line numbers #c2c2c2 in a 32px gutter, keys #262626, string values #ff4d00. Above it, a tab row of 999px pills (Python, Node.js, cURL, CLI) in Suisse 14px weight 450 with padding 6px 12px, the active one #ffffff with the 2px #f9f9f9 ring.

5. Build a section index row: full-width band of height 48px between two 1px #ededed rules. At the left frame edge draw a 2px × 16px #ff4d00 bar, then 28px later the text "[ 01 / 07 ] · MAIN FEATURES" in Geist Mono 12px uppercase weight 400, color #c2c2c2, with only the digits "01" in #ff4d00. Leave the right half of the row as an empty ruled cell.

**Role:** Top-of-page news strip

A full-width ember bar. It uses Ember Signal #ff4d00 as background with Linen Surface #ffffff text, no border, 10px radius, 10px padding and a 40px height, set in Suisse 14px at weight 400 with 0.14px tracking. Inline links are underlined white rather than recolored, and there is no shadow. It is the single place where Ember covers a strip wider than a button, and that is allowed because it sits outside the blueprint grid, above the navigation, as a stamped notice.

### Navigation Bar

**Role:** Sticky top-level wayfinding

A sticky, filled header. It sits on Paper Canvas #f9f9f9 inside a 100px band that includes the banner, with no shadow and a Fog Hairline #ededed rule beneath. The flame wordmark is on the left in Graphite Ink #262626. Centered links (Products, Resources, Pricing, Docs, Blog, Playground) are set in Suisse 16px weight 400 with 6px padding, 8px radius and 32px height, and the dropdowns use small chevrons. On the right sit the GitHub "200K" count and the Dove sign-up button. The nav is centered and symmetric rather than left-heavy, which mirrors the grid beneath it.

### Primary Button — Ember Fill

**Role:** The one action per view

A glowing ember lozenge. It uses Ember Signal #ff4d00 fill with Linen Surface #ffffff text, no border, 10px radius, 8px padding and a 36px height, set in Suisse 14px at weight 450, with the md-2 shadow: an inset darker-red underside plus four hairline orange halos. The inset glow makes the button read as a physical, backlit key rather than a flat swatch. Use it for "Start for free" and for the square submit arrow (60×36px) in the composer, and for nothing else.

### Secondary Button — Dove Fill

**Role:** Quiet account and utility actions

A tonal gray chip. It uses Dove Fill #efefef with Graphite Ink #262626 text, no border, 8px radius, 6px padding and a 32px height, set in Suisse 14px at weight 450, with no shadow. On hover, Smoke Veil #0000001a darkens it one step. The 2px drop from the primary button's 10px radius and the 4px loss in height deliberately mark it as subordinate. It handles "Sign up" in the nav and other low-stakes paths.

### Selector Button — Connect Firecrawl

**Role:** Integration picker with avatar stack

A white split control. It uses Linen Surface #ffffff with Graphite Ink #262626 text, a subtle 2px Paper Canvas ring, 10px radius, 8px 6px padding and a 40px height, set in Suisse 14px at weight 450. It leads with three overlapping 50% avatars of agent clients and ends in a chevron. It sits beside the ember CTA as its neutral twin: the same radius family, no chroma, and a richer payload.

**Role:** Hero query input and mode switch

The page's most elevated object. It uses Linen Surface #ffffff, 16px radius and the xl shadow: six stacked 2–5% shadows plus a 10px Paper Canvas moat. The bare input inside has 0px radius, Suisse 15px and a Pewter Caption #999999 placeholder. Below it, Search/Scrape/Map/Crawl tabs (32px tall, Suisse 14px weight 450, 6px 4px 6px 6px padding) each carry a dotted mono glyph icon. **Role:** Offer callout above headline

A tiny capsule. It uses Linen Surface #ffffff with Graphite Ink #262626 text at Suisse 12px weight 450, 999px radius, 4px 4px 4px 8px padding and the subtle ring. It ends in a 16px Onyx Dot #000000 disc holding a white arrow. It is the only place pure black appears at a visible size, and it works because a 16px dot is punctuation rather than a fill.

### Section Index Label — Bracketed Mono

**Role:** Numbered chapter marker

A blueprint margin note. It sets Geist Mono 12px uppercase at weight 400 in Ash Gutter #c2c2c2, reading "[ 01 / 07 ] · MAIN FEATURES", with the current index digit in Ember Signal #ff4d00 and a 2px × 16px ember tick at the far left edge of the grid row. **Role:** Primary capability entry point

The main content card. It is a 347×212px button on Linen Surface #ffffff with 20px radius, 32px vertical padding, no border and no shadow, sitting in a three-column hairline grid. ## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every headline at Suisse weight 500 with tracking near -0.01em (-0.52px at 52px) — size and color carry the hierarchy, so the weight stays measured.
- Render the second line or key word of each headline in Ember Signal #ff4d00 — the two-tone headline is the signature and repeats on every section head.
- Build sections inside a 1112px frame of 1px Fog Hairline #ededed cells with crosshair ticks at intersections — the graph-paper grid is the composition, not a background ornament.
- Annotate with Geist Mono 12px uppercase in Ash Gutter #c2c2c2 inside square brackets — the mono margin notes make the page read as a specification.
- Lift panels with a 6px Paper Canvas #f9f9f9 ring plus shadows at 3% black or less — elevation is felt as a moat, not seen as a cast shadow.
- Keep controls at 8 to 10px radius and cards at 16 to 20px, and use 999px only for chips and tabs — frames stay square at 0px so softened objects read as handheld tools on a drafted sheet.
- Show code and JSON as the hero illustration in Geist Mono 14px/22px with Ember string values — the product's output is the most persuasive image available.

### Don't

- Don't add a second saturated hue for "success" or "info" states — the chromatic budget is one ember, and a green or blue status color dilutes the meaning of #ff4d00 as live.
- Don't push headlines to weight 700 because 60px "needs punch" — Suisse at 500 with -0.3px tracking is the deliberate restraint, and bold weight would make Graphite Ink #262626 compete with the ember line.
- Don't set the sign-up or selector button in Ember — only one 10px-radius ember fill per view is non-negotiable, and secondary actions stay Dove Fill #efefef.
- Don't replace the ring-and-moat elevation with a conventional 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.15) drop shadow — a visible cast shadow breaks the flat-sheet illusion that 3% layers preserve.
- Don't round the grid frames or section containers — the 0px frame radius is what makes the 20px cards read as objects placed on a drawing.
- Don't use the 8.274px Roboto Mono ASCII texture for readable copy or let it exceed the Frosted Glyph #ffffffdb intensity — it is a halftone screen, and readable glyphs would turn texture into noise.
- Never use Ash Gutter #c2c2c2 for paragraph text, and never drop body copy below 13px — #c2c2c2 on #f9f9f9 is annotation contrast, not reading contrast.

## Imagery

There is no photography. The imagery is the product itself, shown three ways. The first is wireframe browser mockups drawn in Fog Hairline outlines with gray skeleton bars. The second is live code windows in Geist Mono whose JSON strings glow Ember. The third is pixel-dot glyph icons (Search, Scrape, Map, Crawl) built from 2px squares in Ember and Ash Gutter, deliberately low-resolution like terminal sprites. Frames use a 16px radius with square bottoms where they dock into the grid, white fill, a 6–8px Paper Canvas moat and sub-3% stacked shadows. Ember four-point sparkles sit on grid intersections like registration marks, and faint Roboto Mono ASCII clouds stand in for gradients or glow orbs, which this site does not use. Partner avatars include a coral #d97757 mark that is decorative and not a system token. The narrative is a web being dissected into structured data on a drafting sheet.

## Layout

Content sits in a 1112px centered frame drawn as a hairline grid that extends to the viewport edges, with crosshair ticks wherever rules meet. Sections are separated by 64px empty grid bands (up to 143px) and introduced by a bracketed mono index row ("[ 02 / 07 ] · POWER YOUR AGENT"). The hero is centered: a promo pill, a 60px two-tone headline, a 16px subline, an ember CTA paired with a white selector, then the floating search composer overlapping a browser mockup below. The sections that follow alternate between centered heads and split heads (label left, headline right), then fall into a 3-column feature grid, a 2-column code and agent band, and a 6-cell logo ledger. The nav is sticky and filled on #f9f9f9 at 100px including the banner, with the wordmark left, links centered and GitHub plus sign-up right. The footer is a tall ruled block about 1897px deep. At 375px, set the display line at 40px (--text-heading), use a 48px section gap and collapse every grid to one column. Overall density: comfortable.

## Schematic Annotation

The discipline is that the page is a drawing, and drawings carry margin notes. Every section is announced by a bracketed Geist Mono label at 12px uppercase in Ash Gutter #c2c2c2. Grid frames stay at 0px radius on 1px Fog Hairline rules, and corners carry crosshair ticks. Three things break it: replacing the brackets with a rounded eyebrow pill, painting sections in alternating color bands instead of ruled cells, and setting labels in Suisse uppercase instead of mono. To extend the system, add new annotations ("[ 429 RETRY ]", "[ 03 / 07 ]") in the same mono voice, place every new module inside grid cells, and let softened 16–20px objects sit on the square drafting sheet rather than becoming the sheet.

## Single Ember Budget

The discipline is that one hue, Ember Signal #ff4d00, means "live", and everything else is graphite on paper. Ember appears in exactly six roles: the CTA fill, the banner, the headline's second line, JSON string values, index digits and sparkle registration marks. Sand Tint #f9c2ab is its only permitted dilution. A purple syntax token appears in one code sample, but it is mockup-internal and not a system token. The budget breaks the moment a second accent arrives for pricing badges, a gradient washes the hero, or Ember fills a whole section. Extend by assigning new states to tone instead: Dove Fill for neutral, Pewter Caption for disabled, and Ember text (not fill) for anything urgent.

## Ring-and-Moat Elevation

The discipline is that objects lift by isolation, not by cast shadow. A white panel is separated from the #f9f9f9 canvas by a 6 to 10px ring of canvas color plus stacked shadows that never exceed 5% black. The conventional approach, a single 10–15% drop shadow, is what most component libraries ship by default, and it would turn this sheet into a stack of cards. It also breaks if the ring uses Fog Hairline instead of canvas color, because the moat becomes a border. To extend the system, pick a shadow by height (md for menus, lg for mockups, xl reserved for the one hero object) and reserve the warm inset glow for the ember button alone.

## Similar Brands

- **Vercel** — Shares the Geist Mono annotation voice, hairline grid backdrops with crosshair marks and stacked low-opacity shadows, but Vercel holds black and white where Firecrawl spends its one hue on ember.
- **Resend** — Shares the developer-sheet approach of code-as-illustration and bracket-style mono labels, though Resend runs on a dark canvas while Firecrawl works on a #f9f9f9 paper canvas.
- **Browserbase** — A direct category competitor in agent web infrastructure that also uses a single warm accent on light neutrals, without Firecrawl's ruled graph-paper grid.
- **Anthropic** — Shares a single warm orange accent against near-neutral surfaces and a restrained 400–500 headline weight, but leans on serif warmth where Firecrawl leans on Swiss grotesk and mono precision.
